notes.title: “The Aquarium does not dance” Special Edition hits Steam®!
notes.content:
🎉Add “The Aquarium does not dance” to your Wishlist today!

Announcing a special rerelease of the hit horror game “The Aquarium does not dance” for Nintendo Switch™ and Steam🄬! Find out why it has over 600,000 downloads!
*The publisher is Frontier Works.

📅 August 1st: expected release date for the Digital Edition

📌You can add “The Aquarium does not dance” to your Steam Wishlist today!
There is also a demo version available!

🔻New features
- All five heroines are now fully voiced by professional voice actors!
- A brand-new scenario
- An updated and brand-new UI design
- New event CG

This summer, plunge deeper into the waters at Bianca Aquarium with this new rerelease and see what emerges from its dazzling depths.

🛒 Store page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3675470/

📺 Promo video:
 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SmAY_kdqJQY
